cleanup_prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: production game character sprite, clean transparent cutout.
Edit target: the single supplied image. Change ONLY the background pixels and transparency.
Primary request: REMOVE the diffuse glowing beige-gray aura/halo around the character. It is unwanted. Everything outside the exact human/clothing/hair/shoe/backpack silhouette must be 100 percent transparent alpha. No glow, no haze, no shadow, no paper around person, no oval background, no dark fill, no checkerboard drawn into image. Preserve soft one-pixel antialiased character edges, but no broad feathering. Make interior of actual character skin, hair, clothing, shoes opaque.
Constraints: preserve EXACTLY the person, pose, silhouette, proportions, face with no eyes/nose/mouth, hair, colors, clothing, folds, line details, and full body framing. Preserve the original canvas size. Do not redraw person or add features or jewelry. No text or watermark. Output genuine transparent PNG.

assets.name: 陈知远
assets.detail: Subject: Chen Zhiyuan (陈知远), Chinese man age 26, slim, height reference 178 cm. Short black hair with uncomplicated natural contour. Very faint thin eyeglass frame suggested only by two low-contrast curved strokes; no eyes or any facial features behind lenses. Gray-blue plain button-up shirt, deep charcoal ordinary long pants, simple dark everyday shoes, a modest plain dark backpack carried naturally on his back with faint shoulder straps. Slightly inward shoulders and head inclined a little, composed neutral pose.
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: standalone transparent full-body visual novel character sprite for Chapter 1, CHAR asset. Generate ONE person only.
Input images: images 1 and 2 are palette and watercolor paper-texture references ONLY; do not draw or copy the rooms. Characters have their own intentionally simplified pale-ink figure style, much simpler than the reference backgrounds.
Style/medium: minimal fine pale gray-brown ink drawing with low-saturation light watercolor clothing fills, restrained watercolor grain within opaque subject surfaces. Clear human silhouette, natural modern Chinese everyday appearance and proportions. A completely featureless face: NO eyes, NO nose, NO mouth, NO brows or lashes. Same soft warm light skin wash on face and hands; do not make face a white mask.
Composition/framing: portrait canvas around 1024x1536, ONE independent full-length figure centered, head and both shoes fully visible with generous top/bottom margin. Neutral standing pose turned very slightly three-quarter toward viewer's left, hands relaxed. Figure occupies roughly 82 percent canvas height. Consistent common ground baseline about 92 percent down canvas. No cropped body or limbs.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, completely empty around the person; no backdrop, no room, no paper rectangle, no floor, no cast shadow, no checkerboard drawn into image.
Lighting/mood: very soft neutral diffuse illumination.
Color palette: subtle off-white, warm pale skin, blue-gray, muted ink gray, deep gray/navy; no bright saturated color.
Constraints: full body, clothing has modest natural folds, simplified hands, believable proportions. No readable text, no labels, no UI, no watermark. No earrings, ear studs, nose/lip rings or any piercing jewelry. Do not make anime face, realistic detailed face, cartoon eyes, or creepy mask. Do not draw multiple characters or a character sheet.

Slightly inward shoulders and head inclined a little, composed neutral pose.
